_admin_token_comment: Long random string. Required in the X-Admin-Token header for /api/admin/*. Empty = admin endpoints disabled.
_comment: Copy to ~/.hackproof-payments/config.json on the host and edit. NEVER commit a filled-in copy — the SMTP password and admin token are secrets.

smtp._comment: Your mailbox provider's SMTP settings. The password is a host secret — config file only, mode 600.
